冻土融化的“正反馈”与“临界点”如何被建模？

How are permafrost thaw 'feedback' and 'tipping' represented in models?

地球系统模式把冻土碳库与温度耦合，用活化度参数描述随升温加速的分解；部分模型加入 abrupt thaw（热融滑塌）模块以捕捉非线性释放，但仍存在较大不确定性。
Earth-system models couple permafrost carbon pools to temperature with activation parameters for warming-accelerated decomposition; some add abrupt-thaw (thermokarst) modules for nonlinear release, though uncertainty remains large.

冻土融化会破坏哪些人类设施？

What human infrastructure does permafrost thaw damage?

北方许多房屋、管道、道路、铁路建在冻土上；融化使地基下沉、开裂，维修昂贵，还释放温室气体加剧变暖。
Many northern buildings, pipelines, roads and railways sit on permafrost; thawing sinks and cracks foundations, costing heavy repairs, while releasing greenhouse gases that worsen warming.
